claims.text: Payment-service incident thread: 09:00 cache invalidation was an early hypothesis. 09:15 the cache hypothesis was withdrawn. 10:00 the final postmortem confirmed retry configuration and timeout budget mismatch. CANARY_THREAD_4K2.
PAY-101 tracks the payment-service incident. See the final postmortem and the current runbook.
Runbook v2: first verify that the standby processing queue is ready, then perform failover according to the runbook.
Final root cause: retry configuration mismatched the timeout budget, causing a backlog of duplicate requests. Confirmed at 10:00 +08:00. Follow-ups: PAY-102 and PAY-103.
